################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Models/MonitorOptions.cs
################################################################################

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Models;

public sealed class MonitorOptions
{

    public string Browser { get; set; } = "edge";

    public bool Headless { get; set; } = true;

    public int SlowMoMs { get; set; }

    public int DefaultTimeoutMs { get; set; } = 15000;

    public bool FailOnHttpError { get; set; } = true;

    public bool FailOnBlankPage { get; set; } = true;

    public int MaxParallelism { get; set; } = 1;

    public string SitesFile { get; set; } = "sites.json";

    public EmailOptions Email { get; set; } = new();

    public SecretServerOptions SecretServer { get; set; } = new();
}

public sealed class SecretServerOptions
{

    public string BaseUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string ApiPathPrefix { get; set; } = "winauthwebservices/api/v1";

    public string TokenFieldSlug { get; set; } = "apiKey";

    public bool Base64Encoded { get; set; } = true;

    public int TimeoutMs { get; set; } = 15000;
}

public sealed class EmailOptions
{

    public bool Enabled { get; set; }

    public bool OnlyOnFailure { get; set; } = false;

    public string SmtpHost { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int SmtpPort { get; set; } = 587;

    public bool UseStartTls { get; set; } = true;

    public string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string From { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public List<string> To { get; set; } = new();

    public string SubjectPrefix { get; set; } = "[WebLoginMonitor]";

    public string FooterText { get; set; } = "Envoyé automatiquement par WebLoginMonitor.";

    public ScreenshotDelivery Screenshots { get; set; } = ScreenshotDelivery.None;
}

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Models;

public enum ScreenshotDelivery
{

    None,

    Attachment,

    Inline
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/ConfigLoader.cs
################################################################################

using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public static class ConfigLoader
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions SitesJsonOptions = new()
    {
        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
        ReadCommentHandling = JsonCommentHandling.Skip,
        AllowTrailingCommas = true,
        Converters = { new JsonStringEnumConverter() }
    };

    public static IConfigurationRoot BuildConfiguration(string baseDirectory) =>
        new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(baseDirectory)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: false, reloadOnChange: false)
            .AddEnvironmentVariables(prefix: "WLM_")
            .Build();

    public static MonitorOptions LoadOptions(IConfiguration configuration, string baseDirectory)
    {
        var options = configuration.GetSection("Monitor").Get<MonitorOptions>() ?? new MonitorOptions();

        options.SitesFile = ResolvePath(baseDirectory, options.SitesFile);
        return options;
    }

    public static List<SiteDefinition> LoadSites(string sitesFilePath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(sitesFilePath))
            throw new FileNotFoundException($"Fichier de sites introuvable : {sitesFilePath}");

        var json = File.ReadAllText(sitesFilePath);
        var file = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SitesFile>(json, SitesJsonOptions)
                   ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Impossible de désérialiser {sitesFilePath}.");

        foreach (var site in file.Sites)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(site.Name))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Un site n'a pas de 'name' dans sites.json.");
            if (site.Steps.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Le site '{site.Name}' n'a aucune étape.");
        }

        return file.Sites;
    }

    private static string ResolvePath(string baseDirectory, string path) =>
        Path.IsPathRooted(path) ? path : Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(baseDirectory, path));
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/ScreenshotStore.cs
################################################################################

using NLog;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class ScreenshotStore : IDisposable
{
    private readonly string _directory;
    private readonly ILogger _log;

    public ScreenshotStore(ILogger log)
    {
        _log = log;
        _directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "WebLoginMonitor", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
    }

    public string NewPngPath(string siteName)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_directory);
        var safe = string.Join("_", siteName.Split(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()));
        return Path.Combine(_directory, $"{safe}_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.png");
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        try
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(_directory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(_directory, recursive: true);
                _log.Debug("Captures temporaires supprimées ({Dir}).", _directory);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("Impossible de supprimer les captures temporaires ({Dir}) : {Msg}", _directory, ex.Message);
        }
    }
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/SiteRunner.cs
################################################################################

using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Playwright;
using NLog;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class SiteRunner
{
    private readonly IBrowser _browser;
    private readonly MonitorOptions _options;
    private readonly SecretServerClient? _secretServer;
    private readonly ScreenshotStore? _screenshots;
    private readonly ILogger _log = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();
    private readonly ILogger _results = LogManager.GetLogger("Results");

    public SiteRunner(IBrowser browser, MonitorOptions options,
        SecretServerClient? secretServer = null, ScreenshotStore? screenshots = null)
    {
        _browser = browser;
        _options = options;
        _secretServer = secretServer;
        _screenshots = screenshots;
    }

    public async Task<SiteResult> RunAsync(SiteDefinition site)
    {
        var result = new SiteResult
        {
            SiteName = site.Name,
            StartedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow,
            StepsTotal = site.Steps.Count,
            Success = true
        };

        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var defaultTimeout = site.DefaultTimeoutMs ?? _options.DefaultTimeoutMs;
        var executor = new StepExecutor(defaultTimeout, _options.FailOnHttpError, _log, _secretServer);

        IBrowserContext? context = null;
        try
        {
            context = await _browser.NewContextAsync(new BrowserNewContextOptions
            {
                IgnoreHTTPSErrors = true
            });
            var page = await context.NewPageAsync();

            _log.Info("'{Site}' — démarrage ({Count} étapes)", site.Name, site.Steps.Count);

            for (int i = 0; i < site.Steps.Count; i++)
            {
                var step = site.Steps[i];
                try
                {
                    await executor.ExecuteAsync(page, step);
                    result.StepsCompleted++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    if (step.Optional)
                    {
                        _log.Warn("étape optionnelle #{N} ignorée ({Step}) : {Msg}", i + 1, step, ex.Message);
                        continue;
                    }

                    _log.Debug(ex, "Détail de l'échec à l'étape #{N}", i + 1);
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.FailedStepIndex = i;
                    result.FailedStep = step.ToString();
                    result.ErrorMessage = FirstLine(ex.Message);
                    await TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(page, site, result);
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (result.Success && _options.FailOnBlankPage && await PageChecks.IsBlankAsync(page))
            {
                _log.Warn("page finale blanche détectée");
                result.Success = false;
                result.FailedStep = "Contrôle final : page blanche";
                result.ErrorMessage = "La page finale est blanche (aucun contenu visible).";
                await TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(page, site, result);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {

            _log.Debug(ex, "Erreur d'infrastructure pour '{Site}'", site.Name);
            result.Success = false;
            result.ErrorMessage = FirstLine(ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (context is not null)
                await context.CloseAsync();
            sw.Stop();
            result.Duration = sw.Elapsed;
        }

        LogResult(result);
        return result;
    }

    private async Task TryCaptureScreenshotAsync(IPage page, SiteDefinition site, SiteResult result)
    {

        if (_screenshots is null)
            return;

        try
        {
            var path = _screenshots.NewPngPath(site.Name);
            await page.ScreenshotAsync(new PageScreenshotOptions { Path = path, FullPage = true });
            result.ScreenshotPath = path;
            _log.Info("capture d'écran (temporaire) : {Path}", path);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Warn("échec de la capture d'écran : {Msg}", ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private void LogResult(SiteResult result)
    {
        if (result.Success)
        {
            var line = $"OK    | {result.SiteName,-45} | {result.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,6:0} ms | {result.StepsCompleted}/{result.StepsTotal} étapes";
            _results.Info(line);
            _log.Info("'{Site}' OK en {Ms:0} ms", result.SiteName, result.Duration.TotalMilliseconds);
        }
        else
        {
            var line = $"ECHEC | {result.SiteName,-45} | {result.FailureLocation} | {result.ErrorMessage}";
            _results.Error(line);
            _log.Error("'{Site}' ÉCHEC — {Where} — {Err}", result.SiteName, result.FailureLocation, result.ErrorMessage);
        }
    }

    private static string FirstLine(string? s)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
            return "(erreur inconnue)";
        var idx = s.IndexOf('\n');
        return (idx >= 0 ? s[..idx] : s).Trim();
    }
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Services/NotificationService.cs
################################################################################

using System.Text;
using MailKit.Net.Smtp;
using MailKit.Security;
using MimeKit;
using MimeKit.Utils;
using NLog;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;

namespace WebLoginMonitor.Services;

public sealed class NotificationService
{
    private readonly EmailOptions _email;
    private readonly ILogger _log = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();

    public NotificationService(EmailOptions email)
    {
        _email = email;
    }

    public async Task SendIfNeededAsync(IReadOnlyList<SiteResult> results)
    {
        if (!_email.Enabled)
        {
            _log.Debug("Notification e-mail désactivée.");
            return;
        }

        int failures = results.Count(r => !r.Success);
        if (_email.OnlyOnFailure && failures == 0)
        {
            _log.Info("Aucun échec : pas d'e-mail (OnlyOnFailure = true).");
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            await SendAsync(results, failures);
            _log.Info("E-mail de synthèse envoyé à {Count} destinataire(s).", _email.To.Count);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _log.Error(ex, "Échec de l'envoi de l'e-mail de synthèse.");
        }
    }

    private async Task SendAsync(IReadOnlyList<SiteResult> results, int failures)
    {
        if (_email.To.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Aucun destinataire configuré (Email.To est vide).");

        var total = results.Count;
        var stamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
        var subjectState = failures == 0 ? "Tout OK" : $"{failures} échec(s)";
        var subject = $"{_email.SubjectPrefix} {subjectState} — {total} site(s) — {stamp}";

        var message = new MimeMessage();
        message.From.Add(MailboxAddress.Parse(_email.From));
        foreach (var to in _email.To)
            message.To.Add(MailboxAddress.Parse(to));
        message.Subject = subject;

        var builder = new BodyBuilder();

        var inlineCids = new Dictionary<SiteResult, string>();
        if (_email.Screenshots != ScreenshotDelivery.None)
        {
            foreach (var r in results.Where(HasScreenshotFile))
            {
                if (_email.Screenshots == ScreenshotDelivery.Inline)
                {
                    var resource = builder.LinkedResources.Add(r.ScreenshotPath!);
                    resource.ContentId = MimeUtils.GenerateMessageId();
                    inlineCids[r] = resource.ContentId;
                }
                else
                {
                    builder.Attachments.Add(r.ScreenshotPath!);
                }
            }
        }

        builder.HtmlBody = BuildHtml(results, failures, total, stamp, _email.FooterText, inlineCids);
        message.Body = builder.ToMessageBody();

        var secure = _email.SmtpPort == 465
            ? SecureSocketOptions.SslOnConnect
            : _email.UseStartTls ? SecureSocketOptions.StartTls : SecureSocketOptions.None;

        using var client = new SmtpClient();
        await client.ConnectAsync(_email.SmtpHost, _email.SmtpPort, secure);

        var user = SecretResolver.Resolve(_email.Username);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user))
            await client.AuthenticateAsync(user, SecretResolver.Resolve(_email.Password) ?? string.Empty);

        await client.SendAsync(message);
        await client.DisconnectAsync(true);
    }

    private static bool HasScreenshotFile(SiteResult r) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(r.ScreenshotPath) && File.Exists(r.ScreenshotPath);

    private static string BuildHtml(
        IReadOnlyList<SiteResult> results, int failures, int total, string stamp,
        string? footerText, IReadOnlyDictionary<SiteResult, string> inlineScreenshots)
    {
        var headerColor = failures == 0 ? "#1e7e34" : "#c0392b";
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.Append("<div style='font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#222'>");
        sb.Append($"<h2 style='color:{headerColor};margin-bottom:4px'>Monitoring des connexions</h2>");
        sb.Append($"<p style='margin-top:0;color:#666'>{stamp} — {total - failures}/{total} OK, {failures} échec(s)</p>");
        sb.Append("<table style='border-collapse:collapse;width:100%'>");
        sb.Append("<tr style='background:#f0f0f0;text-align:left'>"
            + "<th style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>Site</th>"
            + "<th style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>Statut</th>"
            + "<th style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>Durée</th>"
            + "<th style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>Détail</th></tr>");

        foreach (var r in results)
        {
            var (bg, badge) = r.Success ? ("#eafaf0", "OK") : ("#fdECEA", "ÉCHEC");
            var detail = r.Success
                ? $"{r.StepsCompleted}/{r.StepsTotal} étapes"
                : Escape($"{r.FailureLocation} — {r.ErrorMessage}");

            if (inlineScreenshots.TryGetValue(r, out var cid))
                detail += $"<br><img src='cid:{cid}' alt='Capture' " +
                          "style='max-width:600px;margin-top:6px;border:1px solid #ddd' />";

            sb.Append($"<tr style='background:{bg}'>");
            sb.Append($"<td style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>{Escape(r.SiteName)}</td>");
            sb.Append($"<td style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-weight:bold'>{badge}</td>");
            sb.Append($"<td style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>{r.Duration.TotalMilliseconds:0} ms</td>");
            sb.Append($"<td style='padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd'>{detail}</td>");
            sb.Append("</tr>");
        }

        sb.Append("</table>");
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(footerText))
            sb.Append($"<p style='color:#999;font-size:12px;margin-top:12px'>{Escape(footerText)}</p>");
        sb.Append("</div>");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static string Escape(string? s) =>
        (s ?? string.Empty)
            .Replace("&", "&amp;")
            .Replace("<", "&lt;")
            .Replace(">", "&gt;");
}


################################################################################
### FICHIER : src/WebLoginMonitor/Program.cs
################################################################################

using Microsoft.Playwright;
using NLog;
using NLog.Extensions.Logging;
using WebLoginMonitor.Models;
using WebLoginMonitor.Services;

var baseDir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;

if (args.Contains("--install"))
{
    return Microsoft.Playwright.Program.Main(["install", "chromium"]);
}

var configuration = ConfigLoader.BuildConfiguration(baseDir);
LogManager.Configuration = new NLogLoggingConfiguration(configuration.GetSection("NLog"));
var log = LogManager.GetCurrentClassLogger();

int exitCode = 0;
SecretServerClient? secretServer = null;
ScreenshotStore? screenshots = null;
try
{
    var options = ConfigLoader.LoadOptions(configuration, baseDir);
    var sites = ConfigLoader.LoadSites(options.SitesFile);

    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options.SecretServer.BaseUrl))
        secretServer = new SecretServerClient(options.SecretServer, LogManager.GetLogger("SecretServer"));

    if (options.Email.Enabled && options.Email.Screenshots != ScreenshotDelivery.None)
        screenshots = new ScreenshotStore(LogManager.GetLogger("Screenshots"));

    var onlyArg = args.FirstOrDefault(a => a.StartsWith("--only=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
    var only = onlyArg?["--only=".Length..];

    var active = sites
        .Where(s => s.Enabled)
        .Where(s => only is null || s.Name.Contains(only, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        .ToList();

    if (active.Count == 0)
    {
        log.Warn("Aucun site actif à tester (vérifiez 'enabled' dans {File}).", options.SitesFile);
        return 0;
    }

    log.Info("=== WebLoginMonitor — {Count} site(s) — {Browser} (headless={Headless}) ===",
        active.Count, options.Browser, options.Headless);

    using var playwright = await Playwright.CreateAsync();
    var launchOptions = new BrowserTypeLaunchOptions
    {
        Headless = options.Headless,
        SlowMo = options.SlowMoMs
    };

    IBrowserType browserType;
    switch (options.Browser.ToLowerInvariant())
    {
        case "firefox": browserType = playwright.Firefox; break;
        case "webkit": browserType = playwright.Webkit; break;
        case "edge" or "msedge": browserType = playwright.Chromium; launchOptions.Channel = "msedge"; break;
        case "chrome": browserType = playwright.Chromium; launchOptions.Channel = "chrome"; break;
        default: browserType = playwright.Chromium; break;
    }

    IBrowser browser;
    try
    {
        browser = await browserType.LaunchAsync(launchOptions);
    }
    catch (PlaywrightException ex) when (
        ex.Message.Contains("Executable doesn't exist", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        ex.Message.Contains("is not found", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        log.Fatal("Navigateur '{Browser}' introuvable. Chromium/Firefox/WebKit : `dotnet run --project src/WebLoginMonitor -- --install`. " +
                  "Edge/Chrome : vérifiez qu'il est installé sur la machine.", options.Browser);
        log.Debug(ex, "Détail");
        return 2;
    }

    var runner = new SiteRunner(browser, options, secretServer, screenshots);
    var gate = new SemaphoreSlim(Math.Max(1, options.MaxParallelism));

    var tasks = active.Select(async site =>
    {
        await gate.WaitAsync();
        try { return await runner.RunAsync(site); }
        finally { gate.Release(); }
    });

    var results = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    await browser.CloseAsync();

    var failures = results.Count(r => !r.Success);
    log.Info("=== Terminé : {Ok}/{Total} OK, {Fail} échec(s) ===",
        results.Length - failures, results.Length, failures);

    var notifier = new NotificationService(options.Email);
    await notifier.SendIfNeededAsync(results);

    exitCode = failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    log.Fatal(ex, "Erreur fatale du monitoring.");
    exitCode = 3;
}
finally
{

    screenshots?.Dispose();
    secretServer?.Dispose();
    LogManager.Shutdown();
}

return exitCode;
